SELECT DISTINCT
            a.security_id as security_id, a.pricing_date as date, (a.close_latest / f.exchange_rate) * g.exchange_rate as close
        FROM
            market.cppib_market_equity_pricing_aggregation AS a
        INNER JOIN 
            market.qsrp_market_exchange_rate AS f
            ON a.currency = f.currency AND a.pricing_date = f.data_date
        INNER JOIN 
            market.qsrp_market_exchange_rate AS g   ON a.pricing_date = g.data_date and f.vendor = g.vendor

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     day_of_week(query_date) AS day_of_week_value,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date,
                     query_date AS original_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             final_dates AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as business_date,
                     date_format(business_date + interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS as_of_date
                 FROM adjusted_date
             )
        select
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'BCPP', 'ACPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB GROUP'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_group,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_name IN ('CPPIB Group', 'CPPIB Supplementary', 'Base CPP', 'Additional CPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB Group'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_groupname,
            COALESCE(hold.portfolio_id, '') as portfolio,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_id, ' ') as mpcode,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_name, ' ') as mpname,
            COALESCE(mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code, ' ') as MPFC02,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_code, ' ') as mpfc18,

            COALESCE(hold.security_group_id , '') as secgrp,
            COALESCE(hold.security_group_name , '') as secgrpname,

            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_name, '') as sectypename,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_ticker, ' ') as ticker,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_instrument_type, '') as instypename,
            COALESCE(esc.cusip, ' ') as cusip,
            COALESCE(CAST(esc.isin as VARCHAR), ' ') as isin,
            COALESCE(esc.sedol, ' ') as sedol,
            COALESCE(CAST(hold.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR), ' ') as cppib_security_id,
            COALESCE(esc.bloomberg_unique_id, ' ') as bb_uniqueid_code,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_group,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_groupname,
            COALESCE(esc.cppib_party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,
            COALESCE(exc2.exchange_name, ' ') as exchange_name,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,

                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)

                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency

            COALESCE(esc.esm_ticker, ' ') as ticker,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_instrument_type, '') as instypename,
            COALESCE(esc.cusip, ' ') as cusip,
            COALESCE(CAST(esc.isin as VARCHAR), ' ') as isin,
            COALESCE(esc.sedol, ' ') as sedol,
            COALESCE(CAST(hold.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR), ' ') as cppib_security_id,
            COALESCE(esc.bloomberg_unique_id, ' ') as bb_uniqueid_code,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_group,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_groupname,
            COALESCE(esc.cppib_party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,
            COALESCE(exc2.exchange_name, ' ') as exchange_name,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(esc.esm_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(esc.esm_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,
            COALESCE(und.abor_security_number, '') as secno_underly
        from holdings.scd_holdings_main hold
                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esc on hold.business_date = date_format(esc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(esc.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join holdings.repo_holdings_details repo on hold.business_date = date_format(repo.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and hold.scd_holding_key_id = repo.id_source_holding
                 left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on hold.business_date = mp.business_date and hold.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
                 left join reference.scd_portfolio port on hold.portfolio_id = port.portfolio_id and hold.business_date = port.business_date
                 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on hold.business_date = date_format(asi.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join party.party party on cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esc.cppib_party_id and date_format(party.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join (select id_cppib_party, max(party_group) as party_group
                            from reference.scd_party_issuer iss
                                     join final_dates fd on iss.business_date = fd.business_date
                            group by id_cppib_party) iss
                           on iss.id_cppib_party = cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar)
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes iss_country on iss_country.country_code = party.domicile_country_code
            and iss_country.business_date = party.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes trade_country on trade_country.country_code = esc.esm_country_code
            and date_format(trade_country.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes port_curr on date_format(port_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and port_curr.currency_code = port.portfolio_currency
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes local_curr on date_format(local_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date
                 left join
                     (select exchange_id, max(exchange_name) as exchange_name
                      from (select mic as exchange_id, max(mic_name) as exchange_name
                            from reference.reference_exchange_codes exc
                                     join final_dates fd on date_format(exc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = fd.business_Date
                            group by mic
                            union
                            select exchange_code as exchange_id, max(vendor_exchange_name) as exchange_name
                            from reference.reference_exchange_codes_map
                            group by exchange_code
                            union
                            select 'INT' as exchange_code, 'Internal' as exchange_name)
                      group by exchange_id
                     ) as exc2
                     on exc2.exchange_id = sec.abor_exchange_id
        where (hold.balance_nominal_number != 0 or
                hold.balance_nominal_number_unsettled != 0 or
                hold.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.next_dividend_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency != 0)) T LIMIT 0

WITH rates_usd_to_cad AS (

        END                                                          AS exchange_rate

        AND to_currency   = 'CAD'
        AND mid_price IS NOT NULL
        AND mid_price != 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
rates_usd_to_currency_list AS (
    SELECT
        business_date                                                AS business_date,
        from_currency                                                AS from_currency,
        to_currency                                                  AS to_currency,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1 / mid_price
            ELSE mid_price
        END                                                          AS exchange_rate
    FROM market_uat.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE from_currency = 'USD'
        AND to_currency IN ('AED', 'ARS', 'AUD', 'BRL', 'CAD', 'CHF', 'CLP', 'CNH', 'CNY', 'COP', 'CZK', 'DKK', 'EGP', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'HKD', 'HUF', 'IDR', 'ILS', 'INR', 'JPY', 'KRW', 'MAD', 'MXN', 'MYR', 'NLG', 'NOK', 'NZD', 'PEN', 'PHP', 'PKR', 'PLN', 'QAR', 'SEK', 'SGD', 'THB', 'TRY', 'TWD', 'USD', 'UYU', 'ZAR')

        AND mid_price != 0
        AND rate_type_code = 'SR'
),
rates_cad_to_currency_list AS (
    SELECT
        usd_to_cl.business_date                                      AS business_date,
        'CAD'                                                        AS from_currency,
        to_currency                                                  AS to_currency,
        ROUND(
            usd_to_cad.exchange_rate / usd_to_cl.exchange_rate,
            8

        'CAD'                                                        AS from_currency,

select sum(pnl_cad) pnl_cad,
      sum(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
      sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) pnl_local_exposure_fx
FROM (
        SELECT substring(CAST(business_date AS varchar(10)), 1, 7) year_month, model_portfolio_code, security_id, currency,
		max( business_date ) business_date,
            sum( pnl_currency_exposure_fx ) pnl_currency_exposure_fx,
            sum( pnl_local_exposure_fx ) pnl_local_exposure_fx,
            sum( pnl_cad ) pnl_cad
        FROM performance.pace_holding_pnl
        WHERE performance_configuration_id IN ('PC-POOLS')
        AND model_portfolio_code IS NOt NULL
        AND component_type NOT IN (
            'Cash', 'Spot', 'Constituent FROM original',
            'Constituent FROM spot',
            'Constituent FROM generic decomposition',
            'Residual FROM generic decomposition'
        )
        AND cash_state NOT IN ( 'Settled cash', 'Unsettled cash' )
        and business_date between  date'2025-01-01' and date'2025-03-31'
        GROUP BY substring( CAST(business_date AS varchar( 10 ) ), 1, 7 ), model_portfolio_code, security_id, currency
    ) php
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT aggregation_level_1,
            aggregation_level_2,
            aggregation_level_3,
            substring( business_date, 1, 7 ) year_month,
            max( business_date ) business_date,
            sum( net_cash_flow_reporting_currency ) net_cash_flow_reporting_currency
        FROM performance.scd_performance_seclvl
        GROUP BY aggregation_level_1, aggregation_level_2, aggregation_level_3, substring( business_date, 1, 7 )
    ) sps
    ON sps.year_month = php.year_month
    AND sps.aggregation_level_1 = php.model_portfolio_code
    AND sps.aggregation_level_2 = php.currency
    AND sps.aggregation_level_3 = php.security_id
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            currency,
            abor_security_id,
            abor_instrument_type,
            abor_security_number,
            sum( market_value_reporting_currency ) as market_value_reporting_currency
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
        WHERE (
            abor_instrument_type <> 'Cash bucket'
            OR (
                abor_instrument_type = 'Cash bucket'
                AND cash_state = 'Total cash'
                AND abor_security_type <> 'CB DUMMY'
                )
            )
        AND component_type NOT IN (
            'Cash', 'Spot', 'Constituent FROM original',
            'Constituent FROM spot',
            'Constituent FROM generic decomposition',
            'Residual FROM generic decomposition'
        )
        GROUP BY business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            currency,
            abor_security_id,
            abor_instrument_type,
            abor_security_number
    ) spc
    ON CAST( php.business_date AS varchar( 10 ) ) = spc.business_date
    AND php.model_portfolio_code = spc.model_portfolio_id
    AND php.currency = spc.currency
    AND php.security_id = spc.abor_security_id
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
	  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) as rn
	  FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es
    ON php.business_date = es.business_date
    AND php.security_id = es.abor_security_id
    AND rn = 1
    and php.business_date between  date'2025-01-01' and date'2025-03-31'

SELECT h.model_portfolio_id AS MPDEFS_MP,
h.abor_security_id AS SECURITIES_SECSHORT,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,

h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP

JOIN (
select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
from trades_deals.scd_transactions t
join reference.scd_party_issuer p on t.counterparty_id = p.scd_party_id

and t.business_transaction_code in ('SellFXFwdDbd','BuyFXFwdDbd','InitHoldNom','InitHold')
) t ON h.abor_security_id = t.abor_security_id
WHERE 1=1
and h.business_date = '2025-06-18'
and ((trim(h.portfolio_id) != 'S PARENT' and t.party_name not LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%')
or (trim(h.portfolio_id) = 'S PARENT' and t.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'))
and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
GROUP BY
h.model_portfolio_id,
h.abor_security_id,
t.party_name,
t.trade_date,
h.abor_maturity_date,
h.portfolio_id,
h.security_group_id,
h.portfolio_group_name

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-14')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-14')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

/* cppi::b31e01b8790c97f2ceae62d8a2ec055f41c080bc759fd5b12679044cb9ea201e */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-14')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-14')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end

			select

			from (
				select

				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 00:48:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

WITH

        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-07')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-07')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf

                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date

		, case

		, case

			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc

			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc

			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'

			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]

		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from

)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class"

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 19 and 20

	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 19:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight 423a41cb-ce3b-4591-bc86-1bab58145267 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* cppi::973154ee7d21f7ae1f440e8220d16493c5093e760c9485a8b36c7a13b685314c */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-16')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-16')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-16')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT "business_date" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.business_date", "node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.node", "PV" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.PV", "10 Year Volatility" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Volatility", "10 Year VaR" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year VaR", "10 Year Expected Shortfall" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Expected Shortfall", "var_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.var_pct", "vol_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.vol_pct", "cvar_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.cvar_pct", "strategy_node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.strategy_node"
FROM (-- Step 1: Get program-level metrics
WITH program_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
    program AS node,

    -- Base values
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) AS PV,
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Volatility",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year VaR",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Expected Shortfall",

    -- % Calculations (with null and zero checks)
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS var_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS vol_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cvar_pct

  FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  WHERE program IN ('Listed Real Estate', 'Listed Infrastructure', 'Listed SEG')
    AND hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    AND portfolio_type = 'IP'
    AND hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
    AND (
          analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
          OR (
             analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
             AND confidence_level = 0.95
          )
        )
    AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE '2023-06-30'
  GROUP BY CAST(business_date AS DATE), program
)

-- Step 2: Add strategy_node manually
SELECT 
  pd.*,
  CASE
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Real Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Infrastructure' THEN 'Infrastructure'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed SEG' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strategy_node
FROM program_data pd) AS "LRA- Radar Analytics"

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 10:23:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::5581e98378aa7d32988b4f0d0a260caaa0b647aa5c923f72f0636aabac9abc20 */
SELECT aaa.*, bbb.cppib_party_id 
FROM 
(
	SELECT  
		a.symbol_type_id,
		a.symbol_type_name, 
		a.symbol_value, 
		a.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
		a.exchange_name, 
		a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, 
		a.periodtypeid, 
		a.fiscalquarter, 
		a.companyname, 
		a.companyid, 
		a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, 
		a.totalenterprisevalue, 
		a.sharesoutstanding, 
		sum(a.totaldebtoverebitda) as totaldebtoverebitda,
		sum(a.totaldebt) as totaldebt, 
		a.calendaryear, 
		a.calendarquarter,
		a.fiscalyear
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			st.symbol_type_id,
			st.symbol_type_name, 
			s.symbol_value, 
			ex.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
			ex2.exchange_name, 
			ct.tickersymbol,
			ct.primaryflag, 
			ex2.exchange_symbol, 
			fd.periodtypeid, 
			fd.fiscalquarter, 
			c.companyname, 
			mc.companyid, 
			mc.pricingdate,
			mc.marketcap, 
			mc.tev as totalenterprisevalue, 
			mc.sharesoutstanding,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4192 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebtoverebitda,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4173 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebt,
			fd.calendaryear, 
			fd.calendarquarter, 
			fd.fiscalyear
		from party.capiq_company c
		join (
			select
				fp.companyid, fp.periodtypeid, fp.fiscalquarter, fp.calendaryear, fp.calendarquarter, fp.fiscalyear,
				ic.financialinstanceid, fd.dataitemvalue, fd.financialcollectionid, fd.dataitemid,
				rank() over (partition by fp.companyid, fd.dataitemid order by fi.filingdate desc) rank
		    from party.capiq_ciqfinperiod fp 
    		join party.capiq_ciqfininstance fi 
			    on fi.financialperiodid = fp.financialperiodid
			join party.capiq_ciqfininstancetocollection ic 
			    on ic.financialinstanceid = fi.financialinstanceid 
			join party.capiq_ciqfincollectiondata fd 
				on fd.financialcollectionid = ic.financialcollectionid
			where
			    fp.periodtypeid = 4 		
			    and fp.latestperiodflag = 1
				and fi.latestfilingforinstanceflag = 1
				and fd.dataitemid in (4192, 4173)  -- 4173 = 'Total Debt' | 4192 = 'Total Debt / EBITDA'
		) fd 
			on fd.companyid = c.companyid and fd.rank = 1
		join party.capiq_ciqsymbol s
			on c.companyid = s.related_company_id
		join party.capiq_ciqmarketcap mc 
			on mc.companyid = c.companyid and mc.pricingdate = date'2025-06-18'
		left join party.capiq_ciqsymboltype st
			on s.symbol_type_id = st.symbol_type_id
		left join party.capiq_exchange ex
			on s.exchange_id = ex.exchange_id
		left join party.capiq_ciqtradingitem ct
			on st.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14) and s.object_id = ct.securityid and ct.primaryflag = 1
		join party.capiq_exchange ex2
			on ct.exchangeid = ex2.exchange_id
		where
			s.symbol_type_id in (3,4,13,14)
			and s.symbol_value is not null
			and s.active_flag = 1
			and s.symbol_end_date is null
	) as a
	group by
		a.symbol_type_id, a.symbol_type_name, a.symbol_value, a.exchange_symbol, a.exchange_name, a.tickersymbol,
		a.primaryflag, a.periodtypeid,
		a.fiscalquarter, a.companyname, a.companyid, a.pricingdate,
		a.marketcap, a.totalenterprisevalue, a.sharesoutstanding,
		a.calendaryear, a.calendarquarter, a.fiscalyear
) as aaa
join asset.asset_security_identifiers bbb
on bbb.business_date = date'2025-06-18'
	and ( (aaa.symbol_type_id = 3 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.cusip) or
          (aaa.symbol_type_id = 13 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.sedol) or
		  (aaa.symbol_type_id = 14 and aaa.symbol_value = bbb.isin) )
where aaa.totaldebtoverebitda is not null

        h.security_group_name AS security_group_name,
        sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_term_length,
        sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_term_unit,
        cast(h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as DECIMAL(18,2)) as balance_book_value_qc,
        cast(h.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as DECIMAL(18,2)) as balance_book_value_pc,
        cast(h.abor_maturity_date as TIMESTAMP) AS maturity_date,
        sec.abor_interest_type AS coupon_payment_type_name,
        cast(h.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,

        sec.country_of_exposure_name AS exposure_country_name,
        sec.currency_of_exposure_name AS exposure_currency_name,
        h.abor_security_id AS security_id										
	from RankedSecurities sec
	left join reference.scd_party_issuer par
		on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id and sec.business_date = par.business_date
	join holdings.scd_holdings_main h
		on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
	where sec.rn = 1
	   and h.business_date = '2025-06-18'

/* QuickSight c3f43a15-6658-4325-bbba-373be5e68cde */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'

WITH

  LATEST_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT MAX(source_business_date) AS bdate, MAX(chron_id) AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT source_business_date AS bdate, chron_id AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE source_business_date= date'2025-06-18' and C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT * FROM SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE), -- Select your date here

  IP_PV AS
  (SELECT FACT.analytic_value AS pv
  FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
      risk_prod.dim_chron c,
      risk_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
	 WHERE
	  FACT.CHRON_ID = c.CHRON_ID
    AND c.chron_ID = bd.chron_id
	  AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	  AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	  AND FACT.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	  AND node.node_level = 1),

  ACPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='ACPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  BCPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='BCPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  CE_LE AS (
	  SELECT
		PARENT.party_name,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) AS credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS ACPP_credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS BCPP_credit_exposure,
    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,
    MAX(regexp_extract(PARENT.rtg_final, '^[A-D]{1,3}')) AS RATING

    BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
    IP_PV pv
	  where
		fact.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		/* Exclude all north american government positions */
		AND NOT ( (PARENT.is_government = 'Y' OR PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y') AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA') )
	  GROUP BY PARENT.party_name),

  CE_LE_CN AS (
	  SELECT

	AND IS_POS_FI = 'Y'
    AND (PARENT.SOVR_FI_LIMIT IS NOT NULL)
	  GROUP BY PARENT.domicile_country_code),

  CE_LE_SN AS (
	  SELECT

    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,

    MAX(CASE
      WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')

      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.03

SELECT business_date,
       portfolio_group_id,
       mp.pool_account_code,
       bcpp_unitized_percentage,
       acpp_unitized_percentage,
       scd_unitization,
       CASE
           WHEN bcpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * bcpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_bcpp_core_supp_mv,
       CASE
           WHEN acpp_unitized_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN (
               SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) * acpp_unitized_percentage
               )
           END                    AS herbi_acpp_core_supp_mv,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_pc) AS herbi_total_market_value_pc,
       SUM(herbi.market_value_qc) AS herbi_total_market_value_qc
FROM (
         /* MAIN HOLDINGS */
         select mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                sum(market_value_pc) market_value_pc,
                sum(market_value_qc) market_value_qc,
                business_date from 
        (
         SELECT mh.model_portfolio_id,
                mh.portfolio_group_id,
                mh.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
                mh.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency AS market_value_qc,
                mh.business_date
         FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main mh
         WHERE mh.business_date = '2025-06-18'
           AND mh.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'ACPP', 'BCPP')
       ) mh
         GROUP BY mh.model_portfolio_id,
                  mh.portfolio_group_id,
                  mh.business_date
     ) herbi
/* MODEL PORTFOLIO FREECODES */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT model_portfolio_id,
                           pool_account_code
                    FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio
                    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-18') mp
                   ON herbi.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
/* UNITIZATION PERCENTAGE */
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                           market_value_portfolio_currency_amount AS scd_unitization,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS acpp_unitized_percentage,
                           SUM(
                                   CASE
                                       WHEN acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' THEN unitized_percentage
                                       END
                           )                                      AS bcpp_unitized_percentage
                    FROM finance_accounting.scd_unitization
                    WHERE acpp_bcpp_account_code IN ('ACPP', 'BCPP')
                      AND business_date = '2025-06-18'
                    GROUP BY unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code,
                             market_value_portfolio_currency_amount) unitization
                   ON mp.pool_account_code = unitization.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
GROUP BY business_date,
         portfolio_group_id,
         mp.pool_account_code,
         bcpp_unitized_percentage,
         acpp_unitized_percentage,
         scd_unitization

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-19')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-19')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

/* cppi::840cf1687f9a6e942e551717cf5e8923394e3044c321539ecb3ff06a187a122c */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0
